title: hidden-attractor-search: code, experiments, and results for "Searching for hidden attractors as a rare-event problem: An adaptive strategy portfolio with a worst-case guarantee"
description: Code, numerical experiments, results, and manuscript sources for the article "Searching for hidden attractors as a rare-event problem: An adaptive strategy portfolio with a worst-case guarantee" (manuscript for Chaos: An Interdisciplinary Journal of Nonlinear Science, 2026). The repository contains the benchmark of systems with hidden attractors, the identification and verification protocol, the search strategies (uniform sampling, subset simulation driven by transient duration, active learning of basin boundaries, their portfolio, bisection toward basin boundaries, a stagger-and-step chain, and differential evolution), every numerical result reported in the article in JSON form, the comparison with Attractors.jl, and the scripts that produce the tables and figures.
